sourceInformation.genre: Physics-balance party sports with daily-ritual progression
sourceInformation.perspective: Third person, framed event cameras and an orbitable island chase camera
sourceInformation.tech: Three.js 0.180.0, WebGPU/WebGL2, TSL ink; Rapier 0.19.3; Web Audio; Gamepad API; esbuild 0.28.2; Fredoka 5.3.0; Playwright 1.63.0
sourceInformation.artDirection: Cel-shaded wooden-toy retreat; original procedural models, sea, sky and ink
sourceInformation.animation: Three.js AnimationMixer clips on jointed rigs, procedural physics lean and Rapier ragdolls
sourceInformation.audio: Original synthesised city-pop and bossa, effects and Animalese/Simlish-style voices; music defaults to 10%; no audio files
sourceInformation.online: AI Hub Session Protocol v1 ghost mode for 1–4 devices, plus 1–4 player couch Group Class
sourceInformation.testing: Headless whole-programme playthrough, all 42 event tiers, three bot skills across three seeds, input/audio/save checks, WebGPU and WebGL2, viewport matrices and AI Hub harness. One failure-only test command; no subagents. Controllers emulated; WebKit stands in for iOS Safari.
sourceInformation.research: PLAN.md; AI Hub protocol, client and harness; local Three.js renderer source

aiHub.name: Wee Knit
aiHub.tagline: A little off. A little better.
aiHub.description: A wooden-toy wellness retreat balances on one rock. Hold poses, catch fruit and stack stones with real balance physics, then straighten the whole island one class at a time.
aiHub.controls: Lean: stick, WASD or mouse. Feet: L2 R2, Q E or clicks. Flail: Square or F
